channel.title: Mochi Factory Blog
channel.description: Short, practical posts from Mochi Factory.

item.title: The cheapest image model won our blind test for painted history scenes
item.description: We blind-tested three AI image models on painted history scenes. The cheapest, at about a quarter of the cost, came first.

item.title: Can you hear the difference? A blind test of two AI narration models
item.description: We blind-tested two AI narration models on the same voice and text. The judge called it very close, so the half-price model won.

item.title: For realistic people, our blind test kept the pricier image model
item.description: We blind-tested three AI image models on photorealistic song covers. The model that won painted scenes came last, and the pricier one stayed.

item.title: Printable Graph Paper Actual Size, Without Shrinking
item.description: How to print graph paper with true 5 mm or 1/4 inch squares: match the paper size, turn off fit to page, and check the result with a ruler.

item.title: Printable School Year Calendar 2027-2028 in 2 Minutes
item.description: Print a school year calendar for August 2027 to June 2028 with holidays marked. Two quick ways, one free browser tool and one with no tools at all.
